text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, everyone. Please open your textbooks
to the section on "Probability."

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text: Let us find the solution together. Assuming the probability of event A occurring is P...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ um~.
Math is way too hard~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Hishi Miracle scored a brilliant victory at the Arima Kinen,
upon returning to Tracen Academy, she was just an ordinary student.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like always, she was writhing in agony,
unable to keep up with class.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey, Bamboo-chan,
do you know the answer? Or like, does this even divide evenly?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you can't figure out, just slash right through it with a shinai!
In the end, it's all about fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, she's on the same level as me~.
Someone smart, help us~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, I had the chance to talk
on the rooftop with Hishi Miracle
and Symboli Kris S, the three of us together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So in the end, Hishi Miracle――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't win a single GⅠ, could I.
—Against you, that is.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Not even once? Huh, was that so?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Trainer—you understand, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was just as Symboli Kris S said.
Hishi Miracle was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Classic Year's Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), Japan Cup, and Arima Kinen. And..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Senior Year's Takarazuka Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup, and Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In every single aspect,
she proved victorious against Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
S-So that's what happened... I barely
noticed at all~. Which means...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'm super lucky!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Luck?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah~
I mean, I beat the universally acknowledged
Kris S-chan in seven GⅠ races, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: You'd have to be pretty darn lucky to pull that off.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...What are the probabilities?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, probability...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. What is the probability—
of you beating me 7 times in a row?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, m-math!? Anything but that~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I told you I'm hopeless at math~.
I give up, I give up already~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unbeatable in races. But when it came to math,
Hishi Miracle admitted defeat in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, what's the percentage?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told that, I think about it.
Assuming their abilities are fifty-fifty...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The probability of Hishi Miracle winning all 7 races.
In other words, 50% multiplied 7 times is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait, does that mean...
choice_data_list: It doesn't even happen once in a hundred times.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
1 in 100 times?! Then aren't I
super lucky after all~?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Is that really okay?
Using up so much of your luck like that~..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... That is incorrect.
It's wrong.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I believe.
The probability of 7 consecutive victories is――"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: H-Hundred percent...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Right—it's not about Luck.
That is why—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Mission changed.
First... defeat Hishi Miracle."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"We shall proceed from there.
—Farewell."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the eyes of the departing Symboli Kris S,
there appeared to be a faint glimmer of respect.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fueh~... Trainer-san, I really,
didn't understand any of that at all, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So the chance of 7 in a row is 100%, huh.
Math might actually be surprisingly easy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Against Symboli Kris S, an astonishing 7th consecutive GⅠ victory.
However, that was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Proof not of luck, but of true strength.
Hishi Miracle demonstrated power acknowledged even by that Symboli Kris S.
